::: {#exm-inorder}
#### Inorder of $B$

The inorder (@def-inorder) of the binary tree $B$ of @exm-binary-tree is the list

$$
c, f, h, j, m, p, r, t, w.
$$

It is the inorder of $B_1$, which is $c, f, h, j$, then the root $m$, then the inorder of $B_2$, which is $p, r, t, w$.
The labels come out in alphabetical order,
because $B$ was built so that every label in a left subtree comes before the label of its root in the alphabet,
and every label in a right subtree comes after it.

:::
